admission.justification: The key-plus-scrubbed-value rule and the six-character floor constrain every later log redaction; a future change must re-weigh secrecy against record damage through these alternatives.

alternatives.option: Omit credential-naming keys and scrub credential-variable values of six or more characters wherever they occur; write every other environment value whole.
alternatives.reason: Keeps investigative detail (home paths, ordinary values) while omitting the secret classes the F09 finding demonstrated: embedded short-query secrets and token/authorization keys.

alternatives.option: Write no environment value at all.
alternatives.reason: Removes the home folder from every path and one-character texts from every argument, damaging the record for no secrecy gain; withdrawn by the F09 amendment.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A secret exfiltrates through an ordinary-named variable with retained evidence.

alternatives.option: Omit credential-naming keys only, without scrubbing variable values inside longer text.
alternatives.reason: Preserves the embedded-secret leak the F09 finding proved (a credential-variable value inside a short query); keys alone do not cover values.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Variable-value scrubbing is shown to damage legitimate records with retained evidence.

consequences: Log lines and detail files omit the named secret classes and keep ordinary values whole; later leaves adding logged arguments inherit the same redaction.
context: The tool-call log must keep investigative value while never persisting secrets; the pre-amendment rule (no environment value written at all) removed home-folder paths and chance short texts from every argument.
decider: Developer via Architect F09 amendment (ruling 908be763); current packet MIK-R108@v1 31b43bce.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_tool_answer_table.py redaction tests including test_short_credential_variable_value_is_omitted, test_ordinary_env_value_is_written and test_home_folder_path_stays_whole (passing in the R6 run); documentary corpus notes/reports/l108-f14-documentary-successor/worker-documentary-evidence.json (SHA 6601bb084849a73554f0e385cf90028966b8bbe07831333cc81529e7b6e89725); A8 documentary corpus notes/reports/l108-f14-documentary-successor-a8/worker-documentary-evidence.json
